instruction: Complete the task using command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral schematic package `frequency_stage` is on the desktop. Restore the specified component values/comments. Requirements: - Write `frequency_stage_fixed.edif`, `frequency_stage_fixed.schematic.json`, and `component_properties.csv`. - Set `R4` to `4.7k`, set `C6` to `33p`, and set the `V9` Comment to `SINE(0 1 1k)` without changing unrelated components. Report every component in `component_properties.csv` using header `Reference,Value,Comment`, with an empty Comment when absent. [Software] Altium Designer is available at `D:\Altium\AD26\X2.EXE`. OrCAD Capture is available at `D:\orcad\tools\bin\Capture.exe`. OpenSCAD is available as `openscad`.
